data.title: 木更 · 都市恶魔战斗
data.description: 【木更 · 都市恶魔战斗】繁华海岛都市的幽暗夜空下，完全恶魔化的木更背后展开漆黑华丽的能量羽翼，手中紧握的妖刀在风中撕裂出凌厉的紫黑剑芒。她侧目回望地面的修，眼中交织着狂热与深情——「修的一切记忆都是属于我的代价！胆敢妨碍我们的人，全部都要在这个夜晚斩成碎屑！」
data.action: 恶魔化形态在都市上空战斗
data.promptProse: Kisara leaps across the midnight skyscraper gap with demonic wings unfurled, swinging her cursed blade through a violet arc. Sleeveless black demon dress, red bow and single black glove retain the combat outfit. The dynamic view follows building edges below and shattered glass around the movement. Neon billboards and urban firelight reflect in the fragments, while the blade's violet glow illuminates her gripping hand and wing edges against the dark city depth.
